name: UI Review screenshots
description: Take desktop and phone screenshots of a screen and file them in UI Review in a named, timestamped group (ui-review-item@1).
author: AmberX AXF

data.brief:
Take desktop and phone screenshots of {{app}} at {{screen}} ({{name}}).
Use framework/cli/rebuild-shots.mjs or the app's dev server and a headless browser; then file every picture with framework/cli/shot.mjs <files> --name "<what it shows>" --app {{app}} --screen {{screen}} --group "{{groupName}}" (blank group name: use "{{group}}"). Screenshots only, never the review queue unless the brief says so.
Report the files, the group and anything that looked wrong.
